findings.description: emit() catches OSError and ValueError but not AttributeError; if sys.stderr is None, the write call raises AttributeError and crashes the review.
The progress emit for falsify failure sits only in the RuntimeError handler; a different exception (e.g. TypeError) inside falsify gets no failure progress line.
The global _t0 clock is shared across threads, so concurrent runs (e.g. the MCP server) interfere and report incorrect elapsed times; the clock should be per-run.
